label: Observe/infer attributes
qualification: Selected studies support attribute inference; the combined inventory interface is not directly validated.

label: Build material inventory
qualification: Quantities and composition are evidence-supported; universal probabilistic handoff is not established.

label: Model stock change
qualification: Lifetime/stock dynamics and dated outflows support the function; generic online estimation is a separate candidate.

label: Assess recovery
qualification: Evidence supports recovery-related assessment and reuse information; probabilistic quality-state transfer is proposed.

label: Assess consequences
qualification: Impact calculation supported by studies; the assembled shared-state interface is not demonstrated.

label: S1 to S2
qualification: Carry material alternatives and dependencies through attribute-to-quantity mapping.

label: S2 to S3
qualification: Couple inventory realizations to conditioned lifetimes; update from event evidence.

label: S3 to S4
qualification: Define quantity/time/condition-to-recovery-quality and routing transformation; direct domain validation missing.

label: S4 to S5
qualification: Maintain common realization and dependency information through recovery-to-impact mappings.

label: Shared uncertainty record
qualification: Integrated payload schema is our proposal. Generic dependence mechanisms do not validate the entire schema.

label: Propagation and dependence
qualification: Conditional distributions or covariance for represented variables; compatibility with material classes must be checked.

label: Consistency and updating
qualification: Mechanisms combined across studies; 012 adaptation is prospective and 018 covariance handoff is limited.

label: Decision and communication
qualification: Confidence/U-linked actions support the candidate role; calibrated universal risk decisions are not established.

label: Source/target scale and aggregation
qualification: Explicit scale interface proposed; no universal scalability claim.

label: Event resolution/update/horizon/decision timing
qualification: These four timing attributes are proposed schema distinctions, not all implemented together in one source.

label: Data/model/validation/decision roles
qualification: Role positions are proposed architecture requirements, not empirical role-frequency findings.
